name: Morning Notice: Outer Zones Close, Stairwell Opens
read_aloud: GOOD MORNING, CRAWLERS. House rules update is posted. Outer zones are closed; stairwell access is open. Read the schedule.
narrator_line: GOOD MORNING, CRAWLERS. House rules update is posted.
layout: The backstage green room: ring-lit mirror, folding chairs, the fruit plate, the framed photo. It is the quiet end of the building.

exits.name: STAFF ONLY door to the Graduation Stage (Z10).
The stage wings toward the service corridor (Z S).

features.name: Chairs and the dressing table (half cover if it ever matters).
None; honest saferoom, open to the end (inspired).

quick_run.setup: Morning in the Green Room: the System announces the outer zones are gone and the stairwell is open.
quick_run.decision: Spend the day on loot, on the stairs, or on both?
quick_run.on_success: They leave with a plan and know the early-descent choice is theirs alone.
quick_run.on_failure: They ignore the notices; the speaker repeats them every hour until someone reacts.
quick_run.cut_short: Read the collapse notice and the stairwell announcement; skip the zone color.

loot.text: Box opening during the Long Rest: all earned boxes at once, lowest tier first.

gm_notes: Strong-model notes stay on the Day page. This stub does not copy if_they_do_something_dumb.
